messages:
Priya (CSM): Heads-up — AcmePay usage down ~55% over last 2 weeks. New procurement lead just joined and mentioned pilotting CloudX. Need quick triage.
Alex (CS): Thanks, saw the slack ping. Any note on when the new lead was introduced?
Priya (CSM): Onboarded last Fri — notes show 'Mark P. (procurement)'. He asked for TCO + SLA comparisons in the thread.
Jordan (AE): Mark specifically asked about latency and cost vs CloudX. We have Dedicated perf numbers for similar workloads.
Ravi (Solutions): I'll pull token counts and model routing breakdown. Quick SQL I plan to run: `SELECT date, tokens, model, route FROM usage WHERE account = 'acmepay' AND date >= now() - interval '14 days' ORDER BY date DESC;`
DevBot: Usage alert: acmepay token volume -55% vs 14d avg — https://redwood.alerts/alert/ACME-123 :rotating_light:
Alex (CS): Priya — can you confirm last success call and whether there's any billing dispute flagged? Also need 3 representative prompts for perf runs.
Priya (CSM): Last success call was 2026-03-02, no billing disputes. Customer note: "We're trialing CloudX for latency — will report by month-end." I'll request sample prompts from them.
Jordan (AE): Proposal: offer a short proof-of-performance — 2-week Dedicated canary with our latency SLO + a cost/case study that includes batching/quantization.
Ravi (Solutions): I can build the perf config. Need sample payloads and avg seq len. Priya, can you collect "small/medium/large" prompt examples?
Priya (CSM): On it. I'll ask for 3 examples and average token lengths. Scheduling: trying to get Mark + eng on Tue.
Alex (CS): Action items: I will draft a 1-pager (TCO + perf summary), Jordan handles commercial terms. @Ravi please include before/after perf + cost calc. :thumbsup:
Ravi (Solutions): Will run perf on a Dedicated sim. Command I'll run: `./perf/run.sh --account acmepay --model redwood-7b --seq 512 --duration 600` — will attach results.
Jordan (AE): Suggest offering a 30-day Dedicated trial credit + provisional SLA for the pilot window — ties into renewal timeline.
Priya (CSM): Scheduling Tue 11am tentative. If we can show parity on latency and ~20% cost savings with batching, should reduce churn risk. I'll capture competitive asks in the brief.
Alex (CS): Please add this to the renewal-risk tracker and tag it `competitive-pilot` and `usage-drop`. Keep updates here.
DevBot: Reminder set: follow-up on one-pager Monday 16:00 UTC.
